title: Chat: show when your words reach the assistant

chat.text: Four chat fixes from voice session v-sq8y7db: a "sent" mark on each line once the smart assistant has it, and a check that lines dictated before a page refresh still arrive; a smaller jump-to-newest button near the bottom, plus a check that scroll lock works; a light mic background so the sound-level rings show; and calling the whole thing "chat" everywhere, as a goal rather than a rename for now.
